name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          melos-version: latest
          run-bootstrap: true
          bootstrap-no-example: false
          enforce-lockfile: true

      - name: Generate version file
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MCP_VER=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_mcp/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          FLUTTER_VER=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_flutter/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          if [ "$MCP_VER" != "$FLUTTER_VER" ]; then
            echo "Error: version mismatch: MCP=$MCP_VER, Flutter=$FLUTTER_VER"
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src
          printf "// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND\n// ignore_for_file: type=lint\nconst String marionetteVersion = '%s';\n" "$MCP_VER" > packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart
          dart format packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart
          git diff --exit-code packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart || (echo "version.g.dart is out of sync. Commit the generated file." && exit 1)

      - name: Run Dart analysis
        run: |
          dart analyze --fatal-infos
          dart format --set-exit-if-changed .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          melos run test

  codeql:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: dart
      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
